exposure: internet-based behavioral interventions for tics/habit reversal training
exposure and response prevention for tic disorders
outcome: Yale Global Tic Severity Scale scores
cohort: The study included participants with Tourette syndrome and chronic tic disorders from five randomized controlled trials.
finding: Internet-based behavior therapy demonstrated modest yet statistically significant reductions in tic symptoms (Hedges' g = -0.26) and an increased treatment response rate (OR = 2.34).
